product: KeyLoad development preview. Not production ready.
concept: Orleans does all clustering and copies data through grain calls; every silo has its own ZoneTree that owns its files; API -> one grain per connected client -> grains call ZoneTree on own or other nodes -> gather -> return. See docs/ADR/ADR-136-native-orleans-partition-ownership.md.
